parsed.explanation: With Q defined as the prime divisors of A, a prime in P(x)\sigma(x) may be at most A; A=15 and x=20 gives the omitted prime 2. Thus the asserted disjointness, the induction, and (3) fail. Indeed σ(18)={3} is not good because it misses P(20). Replacing p\mid A by p\le A in the definition of Q repairs the proof's mechanism.
